description: Dam-break Simulation Results of the 10 Largest Dams in the State of Pernambuco - Brazil is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Marcus Gomes Jr (University of Arizona). ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This repository contains hydrodynamic simulation results of 10 largest dams in Pernambuco - Brazil: - Algodões - Saco II - Entremontes - Chapeu - Serrinha - Jucazinho - Lagoa do Carro - Tapacura - Goita - Pirapama The numbers associated with the folders are derived from SNISB classification. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
